title: Is There a Farm App That Works Without Internet in the Philippines?
metaTitle: Farm App Without Internet: What Works Offline in the Field
metaDescription: Need a farm app without internet? See what should still work offline, how syncing works, which rice apps run offline, and how anee.io keeps working.
excerpt: Yes. A good farm app without internet keeps working when the signal drops: you open your plan, tick tasks and write notes, and the app sends your changes once the signal returns. anee.io, a farm app built for Filipino farmers, has offline mode on for every plan, including the free Libre plan, and keeps your recent seasons open on the phone. Anee, the weather and the community still need a connection.

blocks.text:
Signal is strong in town and weak in the field. Many lots sit behind a hill, deep in a valley or far from the nearest tower. And after a strong typhoon, power and signal can stay down for days.

So a farm app that only works online fails you where you need it most. Here is what a real offline app should do, how syncing works, and where anee.io stands.

items: Offline should mean you can still read today's plan and record the work, not just see an error page.
Your changes wait on the phone and go to the server, in order, when the signal comes back.
anee.io's offline mode is on for every plan, Libre included, and your recent seasons stay open on the phone.
Anee, the forecast, maps, reports and the community still need a signal.

blocks.text: What should a farm app without internet let you do?
Test any app before the season starts. Turn on airplane mode, open the app and try the jobs below. If it fails here, it will fail in the field.

blocks.text: anee.io is a web app that runs in your phone's browser or from your home screen. Like many modern web apps, it uses a service worker, a small helper in the browser that keeps copies of pages on the phone. That is how it opens with no signal.

items.title: Open the app once while you have signal
items.text: anee.io saves your recent seasons on the phone in the background. Do this at home or in town before you walk to the field.

items.title: Work in the field as usual
items.text: Open the [activities board](/features/daily-farm-tasks), tick tasks done and write [notes](/features/notes-photos-and-voice). A small bar tells you that you are working offline.

items.title: Let the changes wait
items.text: Every change stays on the phone in the order you made it. Nothing is thrown away if the signal comes and goes.

items.title: Come back to signal
items.text: When the app can reach the server again, it sends your changes in order, then shows the updated season.

blocks.title: Do not clear the browser while changes are waiting
blocks.text: Your offline changes live in the phone's browser until they sync. Clearing the browser's data or history for anee.io before you reach signal can erase them. Sync first, then clean up.
Some work cannot happen offline, because the answer lives on a server. anee.io shows a clear locked screen for these instead of a page that pretends to work.

items: Anee, the smart farm technician, and every analysis she runs.
The weather forecast and satellite views, which must fetch fresh data.
Maps, reports, workers, inventory and the community.

blocks.text: A good habit is to read the forecast and ask Anee your questions while you have signal, then head to the field with the plan on your phone. For more on running a farm from a distance, see how to [manage a farm remotely](/blog/manage-a-farm-remotely).
Which other farm tools work without data?
anee.io is not the only option, and a mix works best. Each of these keeps helping when data is weak or gone.

blocks.text: Weak signal also matters after a storm. Under Signal 5, electricity and telecommunications can be unavailable for long periods. Our guide to [typhoon preparation for farmers](/blog/typhoon-preparation-for-farmers) covers the days before and after.

blocks.text: Sign up free, open your season once with signal, and tick tasks in the field with or without data.
blocks.label: See offline mode

blocks.text: Is a farm app without internet free to use?

On anee.io, yes. Offline mode is part of every plan, from the free Libre plan up to Farm Owner. Libre covers one active season and shows a few ads. If you want to compare it with other free tools, read our guide to the best [free farm app](/blog/free-farm-app-philippines), and see every plan on the [pricing page](/pricing).
Questions about farm apps that work offline

items.a: Yes. Offline mode is on for every plan. You can open your recent seasons, tick tasks, write notes and check growth stages with no signal, and the changes sync once you are back online.

items.q: Do I need to download anee.io from the Play Store?
items.a: No. anee.io runs in the browser of any phone, and you can add it to your home screen. Open it once with signal so your recent seasons are saved on the phone.

items.q: What happens to my changes when there is no signal?
items.a: They wait on the phone in the order you made them. When the app reaches the server again, it sends them in that order and shows the updated season.

items.q: Can I ask Anee questions offline?
items.a: No. Anee needs a connection, because she reads your records and the weather before she answers. Ask her while you have signal, then take the plan to the field.

items.q: Are there rice apps that work offline?
items.a: Yes. The Binhing Palay app, a catalogue of released rice varieties, works in offline mode. For advice with no data, the ATI Farmers' Contact Center also takes calls and texts.
